newsitem.title: USA: Continental Airlines starts Moscow route.
newsitem.headline: Continental Airlines starts Moscow route.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said it received approval from the U.S. Department of Transportation to begin a route from Newark, N.J. to Moscow.
Continental plans to begin non-stop DC-10 service to Moscow effective April 30, 1998, the carrier said in a statement on Monday.

Earlier this year, Continental and Aeroflot - Russian International Airlines entered into an agreement for Aeroflot to buy market and sell half of the seats on Continental's flights between Moscow and Newark.
The arrangement is subject to approval by the United States and Russian governments.
